description: Biomarkers a supplement moves in the Aviado app's evidence graph, one entry per biomarker (strongest edge), ordered by prior_weight (graph evidence weight 0-1, not a calibrated probability or effect size). Each entry has direction (up/down/bidirectional), goal/subgoal, has_verified_support / mixed_evidence, up to 3 PubMed IDs (pmids; URL template in coverage) with n_studies / rct_count, and dose (mean study dose {value, unit}: evidence context, not a dosing recommendation; see coverage.dose_note); null fields are omitted. Partial and non-exhaustive: a missing biomarker is not evidence of no effect. The supplement may be a name or an Aviado canonical_id (from search_supplements or a candidates list). Check status first: needs_confirmation / no_match means the input did not resolve, data is null and next_step says how to retry.
name: get_biomarkers_for_supplement
